decks.notes: The deck focuses on assembling the combo pieces of "Doomsday" and "Thassa's Oracle" to win the game. It uses cards like "Thoughtseize" and "Force of Will" to protect the combo and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck also includes cards like "Dark Ritual" and "Lotus Petal" to generate mana quickly and efficiently. The "Fantasticar" serves as a key component in the combo, allowing for card selection and deck manipulation. Overall, the deck aims to quickly and efficiently execute its combo to secure victory.

This deck focuses on combining powerful reanimation spells with efficient combo pieces to quickly bring out powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Archon of Cruelty onto the battlefield. It utilizes cards like Reanimate, Shallow Grave, and Animate Dead to cheat these creatures into play early and overwhelm opponents. The deck also includes disruption elements like Thoughtseize and Cabal Therapy to disrupt opponents' strategies and protect its combo pieces. The inclusion of additional discard spells, along with cards like Lotus Petal and Dark Ritual, aim to accelerate the deck's game plan and win the match swiftly.

The deck focuses on deploying disruptive creatures like Archon of Emeria and Thalia, Guardian of Thraben to slow down the opponent while also utilizing cards like Chalice of the Void and Anointed Peacekeeper to control the board. The goal is to establish an early advantage through mana acceleration with cards like Lotus Petal and Ancient Tomb, while protecting key creatures with Karakas. The deck aims to maintain aggressive pressure while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Wasteland and City of Traitors, ultimately overwhelming the opponent with efficient threats like Clarion Conqueror and Witch Enchanter.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of lands and disruptive spells. It utilizes cards like Life from the Loam and Thespian's Stage to create powerful land synergies, while also using cards like Thorn of Amethyst and Sphere of Resistance to slow down opponents. By using cards like Wasteland and Ghost Quarter to disrupt the opponent's mana base, this deck aims to outvalue and outlast opponents in a grindy game. The key strategy is to lock down the opponent's resources while building up your own land-based win conditions like Dark Depths and Urza's Saga tokens.

The main concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures like Amped Raptor, Guide of Souls, and Ocelot Pride while also disrupting their game plan with cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Static Prison. The deck also includes removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and disruption with cards like Goblin Bombardment and Wasteland. The inclusion of powerful planeswalkers like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and versatile lands like Karakas and Sunbaked Canyon help give the deck additional options and flexibility in different situations. Overall, the deck aims to apply constant pressure and disrupt the opponent's strategy to secure a quick victory.

This Dimir Tempo deck focuses on quickly disrupting and controlling the opponent's board while putting down threats of its own. By using powerful disruption cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push, along with counter spells like Daze and Force of Will, the deck aims to stay ahead in tempo and prevent the opponent from establishing a strong board presence. Additionally, the deck includes efficient creatures like Orcish Bowmasters and Murktide Regent to apply pressure on the opponent. The key strategy is to maintain control of the game while applying pressure through efficient threats.

The main concept of this Legacy 1 vs 1 Aggro - Initiative Stompy deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan by playing disruptive creatures like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Archon of Emeria. The deck aims to control the board with cards like Chalice of the Void and Clarion Conqueror while also pressuring the opponent with efficient beaters like Witch Enchanter and Anointed Peacekeeper. The deck also utilizes powerful lands like Cavern of Souls and City of Traitors to help cast its spells ahead of schedule and overwhelm the opponent with its aggressive game plan.

The deck focuses on early aggression and disruption through creatures like Anointed Peacekeeper, Archon of Emeria, and Thalia, Guardian of Thraben. It aims to slow down opponent's plays with cards like Wasteland and Chalice of the Void, while utilizing mana acceleration from cards like City of Traitors and Lotus Petal. Karakas offers utility against certain threats, while Cavern of Souls helps ensure creature spells resolve. The deck also includes protection with Sheltered by Ghosts, and card advantage with Seasoned Dungeoneer. The overall strategy is to establish a strong board presence quickly and disrupt opponent's game plan.

This deck revolves around using Doomsday to set up a winning combination with Thassa's Oracle to win the game. The deck uses a mix of card draw, mana acceleration, and disruption to assemble the combo quickly and protect it from opposing disruption. The Fantasticar serves as the primary win condition, providing an alternative way to win if the Doomsday combo is disrupted. The deck aims to efficiently search for and play Doomsday, protect it with counterspells, and ultimately win the game in a timely manner.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill up the graveyard with creatures using cards like Stitcher's Supplier and Once Upon a Time, and then use Hogaak, Arisen Necropolis to bring them all back for a powerful combo finish. The deck features a mix of creature threats and disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to control the board and set up the combo. Additionally, cards like Elvish Reclaimer and Wight of the Reliquary provide additional toolbox options and potential win conditions. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly and efficiently with its graveyard synergy and powerful combo potential.

The deck is focused on creating a fast and aggressive board presence with a combination of low-cost creatures and powerful support cards. It utilizes creatures like Amped Raptor and Ocelot Pride to quickly apply pressure to the opponent, while also using Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Thalia, Guardian of Thraben to disrupt their game plan. The inclusion of cards like Swords to Plowshares and Static Prison help control the opponent's board and protect your own creatures. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with early aggression and resilient threats.

This Maverick aggro deck focuses on efficiently disrupting opponents while using a combination of powerful creatures and equipment to quickly overwhelm and control the board. By utilizing cards like Swords to Plowshares and Esper Sentinel for removal and disruption, as well as Stoneforge Mystic and Recruiter of the Guard to search for key pieces, the deck aims to apply constant pressure and maintain board advantage. The addition of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion provides additional value and synergy with the deck's flicker effects, allowing for more versatile plays and solidifying its position as a competitive and aggressive Legacy deck.

The main idea of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and disrupt their game plan with cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Thoughtseize. The deck also includes various ways to control the board and remove threats, such as Swords to Plowshares and Goblin Bombardment. Additionally, the inclusion of Ajani, Nacatl Pariah provides a powerful finisher for the deck. Overall, the strategy revolves around putting pressure on the opponent while disrupting their strategy to secure a victory.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly generate enough mana to play powerful spells and combo off using The Fantasticar to win the game. The deck includes various mana ramp cards such as Mox Opal and Grim Monolith, as well as card draw and tutor effects like Jeska's Will and Gamble to search for key combo pieces. The deck also includes disruption in the form of Defense Grid to protect the combo. The goal is to assemble the combo pieces quickly and efficiently to overwhelm the opponent and secure a victory.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize cards like Violent Outburst and Living End to quickly fill the graveyard with creatures, then cascade into powerful creatures like Curator of Mysteries and Striped Riverwinder to overwhelm the opponent. The deck also features counter spells like Force of Will and Force of Negation to protect its combo pieces and disrupt opponent's strategies. Additionally, cards like Elvish Spirit Guide and Shardless Agent help accelerate the deck's game plan, allowing for explosive plays and unexpected turns. This deck aims to win quickly by executing its combo efficiently and controlling the game tempo.

The main focus of this Aluren combo deck is to quickly assemble the pieces needed to bring out powerful creatures like Acererak the Archlich and Emrakul, the Aeons Torn onto the battlefield using cards like Aluren and Show and Tell. The deck utilizes a mix of card draw, mana acceleration, and protection spells to set up the combo and overwhelm opponents with big threats early in the game. By efficiently deploying key cards and manipulating the board state, the deck aims to win through a powerful combo finish.
